get.summary:
Get issues with filtering and pagination
GET /api/issues

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filter by status config ID (comma-separated for multiple values)
Per backend-integration-traction-service-v2.md spec: query param is "status"
Maps to statusConfigId filter

parameters.name: TypeConfigId
parameters.description: Filter by issue type configuration ID

parameters.name: BusinessImpact
parameters.description:
Filtering by impact/severity (supports comma-separated values for OR logic)
Valid values: "low", "medium", "high", "critical"
Example: "high,critical" returns issues with high OR critical impact

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
Filtering by priority (supports comma-separated values for OR logic)
Valid values: "low", "medium", "high", "critical"
Example: "high,critical" returns issues with high OR critical priority
Note: Multiple filters are combined with AND, but values within Priority or BusinessImpact use OR
